features.name: Composer shortcuts
features.text: `/` for commands and skills, `@` for files and pixies, `!` to run a shell command, `#` to save a note to your instructions.

features.name: Talk while it works
features.text: A message you send while the agent is working reaches it at its next step.

features.name: Branch map
features.text: Your branches and worktrees drawn as a tree. Start a chat on any of them.

features.name: Feedback back to the agent
features.text: Failed checks and reviewers' comments go to the chat in one click.

features.name: Review before it lands
features.text: Changes wait in a diff. Approve commits exactly what you saw and can open a pull request.
